# pQT Protocol ($pQT)

> pQT Protocol is the first cryptocurrency integrating Central Bank Quantitative
> Tightening (QT) logic with fully immutable tokenomics on Solana, built on the
> Token-2022 standard.

## Overview
pQT Protocol implements a non-custodial, programmatically enforced 0.05%
(5 basis points) transfer fee using the Token-2022 Transfer Fee extension.
Accumulated fee tokens are harvested and distributed by a single permissionless
public instruction, `harvest_and_distribute`, callable by anyone.

## Key Tokenomics & Parameters
- Token Standard: Solana Token-2022
- Transfer Fee: 0.05% (5 basis points)
- Fee Distribution:
  - 80% Deflationary Burn (permanently removed from circulating supply)
  - 15% Public Bounty (instant reward to any wallet that calls the harvest instruction)
  - 5% Dev Treasury
- Withdraw Withheld Authority: Program Derived Address (PDA), `seeds = [b"vault-authority"]`
- Mint Authority: to be revoked once tokenomics parameters are finalized
- Freeze Authority: revoked
- Fee Config Authority: to be revoked once the fee rate is finalized

## Repository Structure
- `/programs/pqt_protocol`: Core Anchor smart contract (Rust) implementing `harvest_and_distribute`
- `/scripts`: Node.js client scripts for deployment, authority configuration, and harvest calls
- Metadata: on-chain Token-2022 Metadata extension, mirrored by the off-chain JSON in this repository

## Technology Stack
- Language: Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript
- Blockchain Framework: Anchor Framework, Solana CLI, Token-2022 Program
- Client tooling: Node.js (`@anchor-lang/core`, `@solana/web3.js`, `@solana/spl-token`)
